reflections.title: "He Has Spoken to Us by His Son"

reflect.text: In times past, God spoke to His people in many stages and through different prophets. In these last days, He has spoken to us decisively and completely through His Son, Jesus Christ. All the ancient promises of Scripture find their true meaning and fulfillment in Him. Because God has given us His final word in Jesus, we do not need to wander about searching for new revelations.

Jesus is far greater than any earthly prophet. While Moses only reflected God's glory, Jesus is the very brightness of that divine glory. He shares the Father's exact nature and sustains the entire universe by His powerful word. When we look at Jesus, we are brought right into the deep mystery and holy presence of God, who now graciously shares His glory with us.

After Jesus made purification for our sins through His death on the cross, He sat down at the right hand of God in heaven. His finished sacrifice brings us lasting peace and assures us of God's unchanging love. Through this good news, we are united to Christ and made co-heirs with Him.

questions: How does knowing that Jesus is God's complete and final word help you trust the Scriptures?
In what ways does the finished sacrifice of Jesus bring peace to your heart today?
reflections.prayer: Father, thank You for speaking so clearly and fully to us through Your Son. We praise You that Jesus holds the whole universe together and has cleansed us from our sins. Help us to rest in His finished work and live in the assurance of Your love. Amen.

reflections.title: The Changeless Lord and His Servants

reflect.text: Everything in creation is slowly wearing out. One day the earth and the heavens will be changed like an old coat, but Jesus remains the same. Great leaders of the past have died, our own teachers and friends pass away, and even our daily feelings shift like the morning wind. Yet the power of Jesus and the tenderness of His heart never change.

While Jesus reigns on His eternal throne, God sends angels to assist His people. Charles Spurgeon wrote that angels are "the unseen attendants of the saints of God." They protect us along our path, celebrate when a lost sinner turns to God, and gladly serve those who will receive salvation.

It is an astonishing gift that heavenly beings are sent to guard us in our daily struggles. We owe all this honor and protection to our Lord Jesus Christ, who has raised us up to share in His heavenly victory and keeps us secure forever.

questions: When your circumstances or feelings shift, how does remembering that Jesus never changes steady your heart?
How does it encourage you to know that God sends His angels to care for and protect you?
reflections.prayer: Lord Jesus, You are the changeless King whose years will never end. Thank You for Your steady love when our world and our feelings are changing. Thank You for sending Your angels to watch over us as we walk with You. Amen.
